policy.scope: Routing aid for residential real-property valuation appeals in the 50 states and District of Columbia.
policy.required_verification: Verify the exact local authority, current official form, valuation date, evidence window, filing deadline, fee, signature, service, hearing, and submission requirements for every case.
policy.deadline_policy: No deadline in this registry is authoritative. Use the owner's notice and current official state and local sources; an informal review may not preserve formal rights.
policy.source_policy: The listed URL is an official starting point, not necessarily the filing page. Continue to the responsible county, parish, borough, municipality, appraisal district, clerk, board, or tribunal.
